ranked.headline: Multi-omics and spatial models infer tumor biology and therapy response
ranked.summary: Single-cell, spatial and histology-based models are converging on outcome, drug-response and regulatory prediction in tumors.

ranked.headline: Graph learning links single-cell multi-omics to enhancer-gene and cell-state inference
ranked.summary: Paired RNA, chromatin and perturbation readouts at single-cell resolution are prompting graph models that link regulatory elements to cell states.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings adapted to function and binding prediction tasks
ranked.summary: Adaptation of pLM embeddings is now targeting bounded regimes: low homology, imbalanced labels, and unseen Gene Ontology terms.

ranked.headline: Graph neural networks predict drug synergy, protein interactions, and modification sites
ranked.summary: Recent graph-based models add multi-relational, equivariant, and causal terms to biomolecular prediction across omics and chemical data.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks reassess omics biomarker selection and survival methods across datasets
ranked.summary: Benchmarks of multi-omics and survival methods now test whether complex models outperform simpler, established approaches.

ranked.headline: Graph and contrastive learning align single-cell and spatial multi-omics modalities
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs contrastive, graph and optimal-transport objectives with biological priors to align weakly linked and spatial modalities.

ranked.headline: Embedding and grouping methods recover cell structure in single-cell and spatial omics
ranked.summary: Supervised embedding weights, Riemannian gene-program models, and trajectory-aware single-cell Hi-C methods extend structure recovery across modalities.

ranked.headline: Deep models for variant effects, splicing, and haplotype-resolved genome analysis
ranked.summary: A ten-predictor multi-species splicing benchmark reports 21–33% AUROC losses for task-specific and foundation models.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks test whether molecular ML predictors hold up under distribution shift
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers audit whether learned molecular and peptide models retain validity when test inputs depart from training data.

ranked.headline: Context-resolved models refine regulatory variant interpretation beyond single tissues
ranked.summary: Proteogenomic, repeat, and epigenomic analyses now resolve regulatory variant effects by tissue, context, and pleiotropic architecture.

ranked.headline: Simulation regime and numerical precision treated as tunable design choices
ranked.summary: Hybrid stochastic-deterministic and learned-mechanistic models now target multiscale biological dynamics with explicit solver choices.

ranked.headline: Biological priors constrain deep learning models of omics perturbation response
ranked.summary: Recent omics models couple causal, interaction-network, and prior-knowledge objectives to perturbation, pathway, and histology-based prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Structural and dynamics information is being fed into protein sequence models
ranked.summary: Sequence models increasingly incorporate AlphaFold features, MD trajectories, and ProteinMPNN-derived sequences to improve prediction and design.

ranked.headline: Physics-based descriptors link sequence and conformation to protein function and design
ranked.summary: High-throughput FRET selection of millions of sequences and temporal MD network analysis now yield quantitative physical phenotypes.

ranked.headline: Open workflows for microbial genome, metagenome, and pathogen variant analysis
ranked.summary: Reproducible, modular pipelines are replacing ad hoc analyses for microbial genomes, metagenomes, and pathogen variant tracking.

ranked.headline: Diffusion and RL generators optimize multiple objectives in protein and molecule design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints add fully atomic one-stage co-design and set-level diversity rewards to multi-objective biomolecular generation.

ranked.headline: New computational methods for single-cell, spatial, and bulk transcriptomic analysis
ranked.summary: Recent tools target preprocessing, quality control, and cross-cohort harmonization, where analytic choices now shape single-cell and spatial results.

ranked.headline: Reference-free workflows expand detection of viruses and contaminants in metagenomic data
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and new tools now test reference-independent, control-free and damage-tolerant approaches for viral and bacterial genomic data.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking causal and correlational methods for single-cell gene network inference
ranked.summary: Statistical models for genomic data are now being stress-tested against realistic pathologies such as dropout and confounding before they are relied upon for…

ranked.headline: Methylation and structural variant tools span arrays, long reads, and single-cell ATAC
ranked.summary: Recent tools address methylation array QC, WGBS segmentation, low-input profiling, and long-read or single-cell chromatin-based variant inference.

ranked.headline: LLM agents paired with retrieval, omics and verification for biomedical discovery
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published pipeline report agents validating oncology targets and auditing LLM diagnostic claims against evidence.

ranked.headline: Language-model and graph embeddings fused with functional and cross-species context
ranked.summary: Pretrained language-model and graph embeddings are being paired with functional, topological, and orthology context for gene and metagenomic tasks.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of polyadenylation sites and alternative polyadenylation
ranked.summary: Single-cell 3' tag-based RNA-seq now allows per-site APA analysis, and new benchmarks evaluate the computational methods doing it.

ranked.headline: Constrained MRI reconstruction of brain iron, myelin, and connectivity maps
ranked.summary: Longitudinal QSM reconstruction and validated myelin quantification extend constrained inference of brain iron and myelin measures.

ranked.headline: Structural information is becoming residue-resolved, usable output for sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers deliver structure-derived residue-level annotations as fast, open tools for sequence-level analysis.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and reproducibility anchor evaluation of genomic prediction methods
ranked.summary: Recent reviews of AI, replication origin, and cell annotation methods treat benchmarks and reproducibility as core evaluation criteria.

ranked.headline: Generative and inference model choices shape protein sequence and RNA ensemble estimates
ranked.summary: Explicit modeling of generative and inference layers now determines sequence design, ancestral reconstruction, and RNA ensemble estimates.

ranked.headline: Learned protein priors coupled to epistatic and specificity models guide sequence design
ranked.summary: A preprint finds simple baselines rival protein language models on dense multi-mutant design, while pLM-guided evolution studies report gains.

ranked.headline: Software tools for reproducible, scalable analysis of metabolic and molecular networks
ranked.summary: Recent open-source releases target reproducibility and scale in metabolic network, interactome, and metabolomics data analysis.

ranked.headline: Agentic systems coupling natural-language querying to interactive spatial omics viewers
ranked.summary: Preprints now embed agentic and closed-loop analysis directly within spatial omics viewers, shifting analysis from static output to iterative querying.

ranked.headline: Leakage-aware benchmarks and reference libraries refine proteomics software assessment
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair leakage-aware benchmarking and reference-based libraries with new search engines and AI-driven PTM and screening pipelines.

ranked.headline: Learned models and curated data advance cryo-EM particle picking and map modeling
ranked.summary: Annotation-efficient methods and large annotated datasets address bottlenecks in cryo-EM segmentation, picking, and atomic model building.

ranked.headline: Assemblies resolve polyploid haplotypes and population-scale structural variants
ranked.summary: Haplotype-resolved alfalfa and a 138-assembly watermelon super-pangenome extend structural variant catalogs to polyploid and population scales.

ranked.headline: Software tools extract rRNA reads, search MAG proteins, and assign peptides from sequence…
ranked.summary: Recent tools reuse shotgun metagenomes and MAG protein resources for taxonomic profiling, ancient DNA analysis, and peptide assignment.

ranked.headline: MS-derived peptides are mapped to isoforms, smORFs and microproteins across proteomes
ranked.summary: Expanded reference sequences and de novo sequencing now let MS/MS peptides resolve to exon, isoform, smORF and genome-level origins.

ranked.headline: Learned and structural criteria extend protein function and design inference
ranked.summary: Protein language model embeddings, domain co-occurrence, and AlphaFold 3 structural novelty now serve as screening criteria beyond sequence identity.

ranked.headline: Computational design and scoring of RNA and protein-RNA structures
ranked.summary: Structure prediction, inverse folding, and quality scoring tools for RNA and protein-RNA complexes are now being benchmarked and extended toward mechanism.

ranked.headline: Accelerated tools for read deduplication, nanopore classification and variant calling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications report reduced memory and runtime for read deduplication, adaptive sampling, and long-read variant calling.

ranked.headline: Interactive tools now visualize protein, pangenome, chemical, and omics data at scale
ranked.summary: Protein, pangenome, and chemical datasets now reach 570,000 proteins to 9.6 billion molecules, demanding scalable interactive visualization.

ranked.headline: Curated benchmarks for ligand and spectral methods test whether models truly learn
ranked.summary: Trivial models scoring well on spectral annotation benchmarks motivates reproducible, automated construction of ligand and spectral benchmark datasets.
